note: Single source of truth for bench QUERIES. Read by bench_rust (include_str), bench_python.py and bench_node.js. Keep the original 9 entries byte-identical for continuity; append new ones only. The optional e2e field is the executable counterpart for the mock-executor suite: bare QUERY '...' has no vector target and cannot resolve against the mock dense+sparse topology (QQL-MISSING-USING), so e2e runs the TEXT+MODEL+USING form of the same statement. All other suites use qql.

queries.name: Simple
queries.e2e: QUERY TEXT 'search' MODEL 'bench' FROM docs USING dense LIMIT 10

queries.name: Hybrid
queries.qql: QUERY HYBRID TEXT 'search' DENSE dense SPARSE sparse FUSION RRF FROM docs LIMIT 10

queries.name: Full
queries.qql: QUERY TEXT 'x' FROM docs USING dense WHERE active = true PARAMS (hnsw_ef = 64, exact = false) SCORE THRESHOLD 0.2 GROUP BY category SIZE 3 LOOKUP FROM categories WITH PAYLOAD INCLUDE (title, url) WITH VECTOR (dense) LIMIT 10 OFFSET 2

queries.name: CTE_Prefetch
queries.qql: WITH d AS (QUERY TEXT 'x' USING dense LIMIT 100), s AS (QUERY TEXT 'x' USING sparse LIMIT 100) QUERY FUSION RRF FROM docs PREFETCH (d, s) LIMIT 10

queries.name: CreateCollection
queries.qql: CREATE COLLECTION docs HYBRID WITH HNSW (m = 32, ef_construct = 100) WITH QUANTIZATION (type = 'scalar', quantile = 0.95)

queries.name: Upsert
queries.qql: UPSERT INTO docs VALUES {id: 1, text: 'hello world', category: 'tech'}, {id: 2, text: 'second document', category: 'science'}

queries.name: OrderBy
queries.qql: QUERY ORDER BY created_at DESC FROM docs WHERE status = 'active' LIMIT 20

queries.name: WithPayload
queries.qql: QUERY 'search' FROM docs WITH PAYLOAD INCLUDE (title, body) WITH VECTOR (dense) LIMIT 10
queries.e2e: QUERY TEXT 'search' MODEL 'bench' FROM docs USING dense WITH PAYLOAD INCLUDE (title, body) WITH VECTOR (dense) LIMIT 10

queries.name: Facet
queries.qql: FACET category FROM docs WHERE active = true LIMIT 10

queries.name: Scroll
queries.qql: SCROLL FROM docs WHERE status = 'active' LIMIT 50

queries.name: Bound
queries.qql: QUERY TEXT :q FROM docs USING dense WHERE active = :active LIMIT 10
